signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in with the username and password you were given.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.forced: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.
changePassword.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

page.title: Account
page.devicesCount: No other device is signed in | One other device is signed in | {count} other devices are signed in
page.signedOutOthers: Your other devices were signed out.

unavailable.suspended: {shop} can't be used right now. Contact the platform team to resume it.
unavailable.noShop: This account doesn't belong to a shop. Contact the platform team.

validation.slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes
validation.moneyKhr: Type a whole number of riel, like 13500
validation.moneyUsd: Type dollars with up to 2 decimals, like 12.50

shops.title: Shops
shops.emptyDescription: Create the first shop and its owner.

newShop.title: New shop
newShop.description: The shop and its owner's account are created together. Give the owner the username and temporary password; they choose their own password at the first sign-in.
newShop.name: Shop name
newShop.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, like sokha-laundry. Can't be changed later.

shop.title: Shop
shop.resetPasswordDescription: Give the owner a new temporary password. They are signed out on every device and choose their own password at the next sign-in.
shop.passwordReset: The password was reset and the owner was signed out everywhere.
shop.revokeSessionsDescription: Use this when the owner's phone is lost. The password doesn't change.
shop.revokeSessionsConfirm: Sign the owner out on every device?
shop.sessionsRevoked: The owner was signed out everywhere.
shop.suspendDescription: The owner can still sign in but can't use the shop. Its ticket pages show "unavailable". Nothing is deleted.
shop.resumeDescription: The owner can use the shop again.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: The slips this shop's owner can fill. The owner picks the default.
templates.none: No template yet: the owner can't take orders until one is attached.

details.title: Shop details
details.description: What the shop’s slips print. The owner asks the platform to change them.
details.currencyHelp: Amounts on new orders are in this currency.

more.title: More
more.supportDescription: A change to your slip, a problem: message us and we'll set it up for you.

save.conflictMessage: This template changed in another window. Reload to see it.

desktopOnly.title: Open the studio on a computer
desktopOnly.description: The studio needs a screen at least 1280 pixels wide.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: The picture the customer gets, with sample values.
preview.alt: The slip as the customer gets it
preview.failed: The preview couldn't be made. Try again.

publish.title: Publish version {number}?
publish.description: New orders use it at once. Orders already made keep the version they were made on.
publish.allGood: Everything a slip needs is there.

errors.noOrderNo: Add an Order No. field (Fields panel).
errors.htmlEmpty: The slip has no HTML yet. Pick a preset or write it in the editor.
errors.htmlInvalid: The HTML has problems: see the list under the markup.
errors.htmlRenderFailed: The slip could not be rendered with sample order data.
errors.missingPrintBinding: {name} is required on the slip but isn’t in the HTML. Click inside its box, then Intake fields → Insert.

warnings.noFields: The owner has no fields to fill.
warnings.noPaperSize: No paper size: printed slips take the paper's width (⋯ → Paper size).
warnings.unplacedField: {name} isn’t printed on the slip. Insert it (Intake fields → Insert), or mark it Keep off the slip.
warnings.noOrderNumber: The slip doesn’t print the order number, which matches a slip to its order at pickup. Add {'{{'}order.number{'}}'} to show it.
warnings.noQrCode: The slip doesn’t print a QR code for the customer to scan. Add {'{{'}order.qrCode{'}}'} to show it.

list.title: Templates
list.emptyDescription: Create an HTML template for a shop's paper slip.

toolbar.none: Select an element to change it. Shift adds to the selection; drag on the canvas to select several.

form.fixedHint: The app uses these to list and search orders. One of each per template.
form.fillOrderHint: Next goes through the fields in this order. Drag to change it.
form.noFields: Add a field the owner fills.

field.label: Label
field.labelHint: What the owner sees while filling: write it in the language the shop reads (Khmer is fine). Needed to publish.

tryIt.title: Try it
tryIt.description: Fill the slip as the owner will. Nothing is saved.

archive.banner: This template is archived: it can't be changed or attached. Restore it to use it again.
archive.confirmDescription: It's detached from every shop and hidden from the list. Orders made on it keep their slips.

artwork.rules: PNG, JPEG or SVG, 200–2000 pixels a side. An SVG is turned into a PNG in your browser; a file over 1 MB is made smaller.
artwork.previewAlt: The artwork as the slip will use it

changes.fromSvg: Turned from SVG into PNG in your browser. Check the text looks right.
changes.scaledDown: Made smaller to 2000 pixels on its long side.
changes.reencoded: Saved as JPEG to stay under 1 MB.

artwork.soft: This artwork is under {side} pixels on its long side: the customer's picture will look soft.

problems.unsupported: Choose a PNG, JPEG or SVG file.
problems.unreadable: This file couldn't be read as an image.
problems.tooSmall: The artwork must be at least 200 pixels on each side.
problems.tooHeavy: The artwork is still over 1 MB after making it smaller. Use a simpler design or a smaller size.

artwork.replaceDescription: The canvas takes the new artwork's size. Fields stay where they are; check them afterwards.

paper.title: Paper size
paper.description: The printed slip's size in millimetres. Each published version keeps it, so a reprint comes out the same.

html.name: Template name

ai.pastePlaceholder: Paste the JSON your AI answered

images.description: Pick an image to put it in the HTML at the cursor, or upload one. Size it with a width class such as w-24.
images.rules: PNG, JPEG or SVG, 200–2000 pixels a side. An SVG is turned into a PNG in your browser. A slip's images add up to at most 1 MB. For a logo with sharp edges at any size, paste it into the markup as inline SVG instead.
images.none: No images in the library yet. Upload one above.

html.promptHint: Give the prompt and a photo of the shop's slip to your AI, then paste its answer with Import JSON.
html.briefPlaceholder: Keep the layout of the photo, or what to change
html.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it.
html.importHint: Paste the JSON object your AI answered. The markup replaces the current one; fields, paper size and shops stay.
html.reviewNotes: The AI asks you to check
html.fieldsHint: What staff enter on each order. Place each field in the HTML so the slip prints it, then check it with Test order. Staff type the total unless a count or weight is linked under Pricing. ✱ marks a required field.
html.builtInHint: Every order has this. Rename it, but it can’t be removed.
html.noItems: No items yet. Add them from the list or add your own.
html.usedHint: The HTML prints this field. Remove {placeholder} from the HTML first.

customSample.title: Test order
customSample.description: Enter an example order to check where each value prints. A test creates no order.
customSample.totalHint: Type the total, as staff will. Leave blank to use the sample total.

html.previewAlt: The slip with a sample order

itemList.title: Add from the item list
itemList.description: Pick the items staff enter on this slip. Each one records a quantity or a tick; staff type the total unless you link it under Pricing.
itemList.empty: No item matches. Use Add field for something not on the list.
itemList.add: Add fields | Add {count} field | Add {count} fields
itemList.tooMany: This slip has room for {count} more fields.

presetPicker.description: Pick how the shop charges. The preset fills in the HTML and intake fields, and you can change both afterwards.
presetPicker.locked: A preset starts an empty slip. Clear the HTML to use one.

hints.byWeight: Staff enter the weight in kg and type the total.
hints.byItem: Staff count each garment on the grid and type the total.
hints.mixed: Staff enter the kilos, the common pieces, the services and who received it, as most paper slips have.

empty.title: Start your slip
empty.description: Write HTML here, paste code from your AI tool, or start from a preset.
empty.readOnly: This template has no HTML yet.

html.replacePreset: Replace the intake fields you edited with the preset’s fields?
html.paperRatio: Choose a less narrow paper size so the slip can render at the right proportions.
html.previewMouseHint: Ctrl/⌘ + wheel to zoom · Drag to pan
html.previewKeyboardHint: Use the arrow keys to pan when zoomed in.
html.printSampleFailed: Couldn't open the sample print dialog.
html.previewInvalid: Fix the HTML errors to show a preview.

placement.summaryUnplaced: {count} field not placed | {count} field not placed | {count} fields not placed
placement.insertHint: Click inside the field’s box in the HTML first; Insert puts its placeholder there.

html.requiredPortalOnly: Required: staff must enter it. It stays off the slip.

assign.title: Publish version {number} and assign it to {shop}?
assign.description: {shop} will use this slip for new orders. Orders already saved keep the version they were made on.
assign.failed: Version {number} is published, but it isn’t assigned to {shop} yet.
assign.done: Version {number} is published and assigned to {shop}.
assign.shopMissing: The shop this slip was being set up for can’t be found. Publish works as usual; assign it from Shops.

slipFill.nothingToFill: This slip has nothing to fill.

new.title: New order
new.slipUpdated: This paper slip was just updated. Check the order, then save it again.
new.noSlipDescription: Your shop's paper slip isn't set up yet, so orders can't be taken. Contact support to set it up.
new.copiedFrom: A copy of order No. {number}, which is cancelled. Check it and save: it gets a new number.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: Check the slip. The order number is given when you save.
preview.retryHint: Nothing was lost. Try again: the order is saved only once.

slip.label: The order's slip
slip.numberPlaceholderLabel: The order number is given on save

order.title: Order No. {number}
order.savedHint: Write this number on the bag.

actions.pickUpUnpaidDescription: This order isn't paid yet. It is marked picked up and stays unpaid; you can still mark it paid later.
actions.cancelDescription: The order stays in the list as cancelled. Its number is not used again.
actions.cancelPaidDescription: The order stays in the list as cancelled and still shows it was paid. Its number is not used again.
actions.copyTitle: Cancel order No. {number} and copy it?
actions.copyDescription: Order No. {number} is cancelled. A new order opens with the same details for you to fix; it gets a new number.
actions.copyPaidDescription: Order No. {number} is cancelled and still shows it was paid. A new order opens with the same details, marked paid; check it before saving. It gets a new number.

slips.title: Paper slips
slips.intro: The slips the platform made for your shop. New order starts on the default one. To change a slip's design, contact support.
slips.defaultSaved: New orders now start on this slip.
slips.sampleNote: Sample values. Your orders show their own.
slips.changeDescription: To change a price, add an item or move a box on your slip, message us on Telegram. We update the slip for you.

telegram.title: Slip on Telegram
telegram.hint: The customer scans this with the phone's camera and taps Start: the bot sends them this slip.
telegram.qrLabel: QR code for the customer's Telegram
